about: Amendments that carry out docs/decisions/2026-10-29-glossary-ruling-conflicts-resolved.md, [USER]'s decisions on the 35 headwords where the chemistry glossary and the 2026-10-26 ruling set disagreed. Read by tools/ai-review/compile-ruling-set.js --amendments (readAmendments). Each retarget and remove names the CURRENT target as from, so the compiler refuses if this file meets a set it was not written against. The nine rulings that stand, and isomers, intermolecular force and calorimetry (number is not a conflict, entry rule 3), need no amendment and have none. The two corrections to our copy of the glossary (valence, concentrated) are not made here: they go through the concept model. Entries carrying their own `record` carry out docs/decisions/2026-10-29-heat-compounds-and-symbol-trims.md, decided later the same day. Hand-written input: its sha256 is recorded in the compiled artifact, so any edit must be followed by a recompile.
